recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body studio portrait of a woman in a seated, modest pose against a warm, gradient studio backdrop. The composition is framed by bold, red display typography at the top and a structured block of credits at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between two distinct typographic zones
Warm skin tones harmonizing with the ochre-to-tan gradient background
High-contrast red text acting as a vibrant frame against the muted palette
Symmetrical body positioning creating a stable visual anchor
coreInvariants: Warm, diffused studio lighting with soft shadows
Gradient background transitioning from dark ochre to light tan
Bold, condensed serif display type for the primary title
Strict horizontal alignment of all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, mid-ground, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large red title above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title -> Subject's face -> Subject's pose -> Bottom credit block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room on the left and right sides to emphasize the central figure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark brunette hair (subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy background values allow the high-saturation red text to pop forward.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary red

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
Integrated silhouette graphic within one of the characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' or 'E' modified to contain a small illustrative silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed serif for titles paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Bullet points separating names in the bottom block
Subtle horizontal rule or spacing to define the footer

preserve: Tight kerning of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display title.
Suitable for the structured metadata block at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with long dark hair, seated in a modest, cross-legged pose on a light tan floor. The background is a smooth gradient from dark ochre at the top to light tan at the bottom. Lighting is warm and soft, typical of 90s editorial photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, condensed red serif title at the top, with letters nearly touching. Add a block of small, red, all-caps sans-serif text at the bottom, organized into centered rows with bullet points.

verificationChecks: Is the main title red and condensed?
Is the subject centered with a warm gradient background?
Is the bottom text block aligned and colored red?
Is the overall mood reminiscent of a 90s film poster?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for typography
mustRedesign: Specific artist names in the credits

avoid: Loose, airy kerning in the title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Check that the red text is legible against the ochre background
Verify the gradient transition is smooth without banding
Confirm the bottom text block is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered warm-toned studio portrait with a top-heavy condensed red serif title and a structured red footer block for a classic cinematic aesthetic.
